citation: Kim et al. 2025. Combinatorial CRISPR screen of tyrosine kinases in MDA-MB-231 (FYN/KDM4 and TKI resistance). eLife 12:RP93921.
label_rule: positive = authors' 30 hits (bold in supp2): normalized GI < -2 AND RIGER p(GI) < 0.01 AND observed double-KO growth Z < -5 (paper states only the first two; 40 pairs pass those, the bold 30 are exactly the subset with Z < -5; the 10 others -> null). negative = |normalized GI| < 1 AND RIGER p(GI) > 0.05. else null. Self pairs and NegCon rows dropped. score = normalized GI (local z-score, negative = SL), signif = RIGER p of GI.

own_replication.reason: Only the gene-level table merged over 3 bio replicates, both orientations and 3x3 sgRNA pairs is published (supp2). No counts table; BioProject PRJNA976939 has no public SRA/ENA runs (checked 2026-09-25). replicates() returns an empty frame.
own_replication.author_reported: growth-phenotype Z (not GI): r=0.50 between AB/BA orientations, r=0.74 between bio replicates #2 and #3 (Z is dominated by single-gene effects, so this says little about GI reproducibility)

same_line_MDA-MB-231.note: only 4 of our 30 positives overlap (BTK-ITK, SRC-YES1, FGFR2-FGFR4, FGFR2-PDGFRA); flister diff_z for them = +0.21, -0.09, +0.67, +1.29 (none negative-strong); Spearman of scores over 227 shared pairs = -0.12; flister has 0 positives among the shared pairs

cross_study.ford2023: also MDA-MB-231, being built by another agent; not checked
cross_study.summary: no informative cross-study test (max 4 overlapping positives); what little there is does not support the labels (AUROC 0.42 same line, 0.19-0.62 other lines, all n_pos <= 4)

hit_concentration.note: authors state FGFR2, FRK and TEK are not expressed at appreciable levels in MDA-MB-231; BTK/ITK (another hit) are haematopoietic

verdict_reason: No own-replication evidence is possible (no per-replicate/orientation GI or counts published; SRA runs not public) and no usable cross-study test exists (4 overlapping positives with flister2025 in MDA-MB-231, AUROC 0.42, score Spearman -0.12). Beyond failing the gate, 22/30 positives involve FGFR2, FRK or TEK, genes the authors themselves report as not expressed in MDA-MB-231 (TEK alone is in 10 hits), so most calls are likely guide/noise artefacts of a 76-gene screen with GI normalised by local neighbourhood SD. Hit rate (1.05%) is plausible and fitness does not predict labels (0.51), but that is not enough. Not recommended even as measurements-only: the only same-line comparison of scores is slightly anti-correlated.
